segments.normalizedSource: ```swift struct ContentView: View { @State private var location = CGPoint.zero var body: some View { VStack { Color.red.frame(width: 100, height: 100) .overlay(circle) Text("Location: \(Int(location.x)), \(Int(location.y))") } .coordinateSpace(.named("stack")) } var circle: some View { Circle() .frame(width: 25, height: 25) .gesture(drag) .padding(5) } var drag: some Gesture { DragGesture(coordinateSpace: .named("stack")) .onChanged { info in location = info.location } } } ```
